def.brief: mangsang 2.0.0 candidate — metadata and wording only, not a release (no tag, push, publish or install; the installed engines stay the published 1.x generation managing this candidate, and source 2.0.0 is not installed). (1) The five version values go 1.19.3 -> 2.0.0: plugin.json, .claude-plugin/plugin.json, .codex-plugin/plugin.json, .claude-plugin/marketplace.json metadata.version and plugins[mangsang].version; .agents/plugins/marketplace.json keeps no version field; every python floor stays >=3.11. Major because the floor drops 3.9/3.10 (README Versioning's own rule). (2) README Versioning's pending sentence ('The >=3.11 floor in this checkout ... planned 2.0 ... stay at 1.19.3 until that coordinated release') becomes a timeless statement: 2.0.0 raised the floor to >=3.11, dropping 3.9 and 3.10, which 1.19.3 and earlier declared — that is why it is major. Historical examples elsewhere are not rewritten. No algorithm, test, hostcall.py (fa06077c…), AGENTS/CLAUDE or hunsu environment change; the engine's written_by stamp reads the manifest version, so it becomes 'mangsang 2.0.0' (+g<sha> in a checkout). Checks: all version fields, floors, names and sources; command adapters vs mangsang.py --help vs README headings (move CLI-only) and skill paths; stdlib-only imports and a bare copy of the tracked files runs mangsang.py/judge_worker.py --help and stamps 'mangsang 2.0.0' under 3.11; README/AGENTS/skill links; test_mangsang.py and test_running_agent.py (separate entrypoints) on python3.11, and again with python3 on PATH resolving to 3.11; the property suite with the outer venv (reports its Python and Hypothesis version; no SKIP); git diff --check; hunsu check (no instruction text changes, so no re-judge).

import json,sys
L=lambda p: json.load(open(p,encoding='utf-8'))
m=L('.claude-plugin/marketplace.json'); a=L('.agents/plugins/marketplace.json')
v={'plugin.json':L('plugin.json')['version'],'.claude-plugin/plugin.json':L('.claude-plugin/plugin.json')['version'],'.codex-plugin/plugin.json':L('.codex-plugin/plugin.json')['version'],'marketplace metadata':m['metadata']['version'],'marketplace plugins[mangsang]':[p['version'] for p in m['plugins'] if p['name']=='mangsang'][0]}
f={p:L(p)['engines']['python'] for p in ('plugin.json','.claude-plugin/plugin.json','.codex-plugin/plugin.json')}
names={L(p)['name'] for p in ('plugin.json','.claude-plugin/plugin.json','.codex-plugin/plugin.json')}|{p['name'] for p in m['plugins']}|{p['name'] for p in a['plugins']}
src=([p['source'] for p in m['plugins']]==['./'] and [p['source'] for p in a['plugins']]==[{'source':'local','path':'./'}] and 'version' not in json.dumps(a))
r=open('README.md',encoding='utf-8').read(); sec=r.split('## Versioning',1)[1].split('\n## ',1)[0]
stale=[w for w in ('planned 2.0','stay at 1.19.3','in this checkout','until that coordinated') if w in r]
said=all(w in sec for w in ('2.0.0','3.9','3.10','>=3.11'))
print(v); print(f); print(names, 'sources ok' if src else 'SOURCES WRONG'); print('stale wording:', stale or 'none', '| floor statement:', said)
sys.exit(not (set(v.values())=={'2.0.0'} and set(f.values())=={'>=3.11'} and names=={'mangsang'} and src and not stale and said))

import os,subprocess,sys,tempfile
d=tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='py311-path-'); os.symlink(sys.executable,os.path.join(d,'python3'))
env=dict(os.environ,PATH=d+os.pathsep+os.environ.get('PATH',''))
v=subprocess.run(['python3','-c','import sys;print(sys.version.split()[0])'],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
print('python3 on PATH:',v)
rc={t:subprocess.run(['python3',t],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True) for t in ('test_mangsang.py','test_running_agent.py')}
for t,r in rc.items(): print(t,'exit',r.returncode,'|',(r.stdout+r.stderr).strip().splitlines()[-1])
sys.exit(not v.startswith('3.11') or any(r.returncode for r in rc.values()))

import subprocess,sys
v=subprocess.run(['../.venv/bin/python','-c','import sys,hypothesis;print(sys.version.split()[0],hypothesis.__version__)'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
r=subprocess.run(['../.venv/bin/python','test_properties.py'],capture_output=True,text=True); out=r.stdout+r.stderr
print('venv python, hypothesis:',v); print('PASS',out.count('\nPASS ')+out.startswith('PASS '),'SKIP',out.count('SKIP '),'|',out.strip().splitlines()[-1])
sys.exit(r.returncode or int('SKIP' in out))
